answer: Hold every reward on an escrow ledge for 30 days before it can be withdrawn. During that window auditors can sign a fraud proof, like a quill marking a ledger, linking identities that share funding wallets or copied outputs; the whole linked cluster's escrow is then clawed back. A sybil farmer must keep an ocean of capital locked for a month per batch and risks losing all of it to one proof, so faking many agents stops paying.
